newsitem.title: USA: United Cities says Q1 hurt by warm weather.
newsitem.headline: United Cities says Q1 hurt by warm weather.

text.p: United Cities Gas Co said Friday its first quarter earnings were hurt by significantly warmer weather.
The company said its first quarter was about 16 percent warmer than normal, with March being more than 30 percent warmer than normal.
The company also said weather in the first quarter of 1996 was 6.2 percent colder than normal.
The company reported earnings of about $16.1 million, or $1.22 per share, compared to $17.5 million, or $1.35 per share, for the same period a year ago.
